shelters.name: Oregon Humane Society
shelters.description: Oregon-based nonprofit with Portland and Salem campuses. Finds homes for nearly 12,000 pets annually. Second Chance program brings 7,500 pets from partner shelters.

shelters.name: Oregon Humane Society Salem Campus
shelters.description: Salem campus of Oregon Humane Society. Open 10am-7pm daily for adoptions.

shelters.name: Greenhill Humane Society
shelters.description: Caring for animals in Lane County since 1944. Only life-saving animal shelter within the Eugene/Springfield area.

shelters.name: Oregon Dog Rescue
shelters.description: No-kill shelter since 2007 serving greater Portland. 501(c)(3) nonprofit preparing close to 2,000 dogs annually for adoption. Supported by donations and adoption fees.

shelters.name: SafeHaven Humane Society
shelters.description: Private nonprofit animal shelter serving the needs of over 2,500 pets each year.

shelters.name: Homeward Bound Pets Humane Society
shelters.description: Oregon's FIRST no-kill shelter. Helping cats and dogs in McMinnville and Yamhill County for nearly 50 years.

shelters.name: The Pixie Project
shelters.description: Nonprofit animal adoption center and rescue offering pet adoption, owner education, and low cost spay/neuter and veterinary services.

shelters.name: Cat Adoption Team
shelters.description: Cat rescue organization serving the Portland metro area.

shelters.name: Animal Aid
shelters.description: Animal rescue organization serving Portland and surrounding communities.

shelters.name: Multnomah County Animal Services
shelters.description: County animal services serving Multnomah County and the greater Portland area.

shelters.name: Willamette Humane Society
shelters.description: Humane society serving Salem and the Willamette Valley.

shelters.name: Indigo Rescue
shelters.description: Animal rescue organization serving Beaverton and the Portland metro west area.

shelters.name: Kitsap Humane Society
shelters.description: Humane society serving Klamath Falls and southern Oregon.

shelters.name: Rogue Valley Humane Society
shelters.description: Humane society serving Grants Pass and the Rogue Valley in southern Oregon.

shelters.name: Heartland Humane Society
shelters.description: Humane society serving Corvallis and Benton County.

notes: Comprehensive collection of Oregon animal shelters, humane societies, and rescue organizations. Oregon Humane Society finds homes for 12,000 pets annually. Greenhill Humane Society has served since 1944. Homeward Bound Pets is Oregon's first no-kill shelter. Coverage spans Portland, Salem, Eugene, McMinnville, Corvallis, and southern Oregon.
